title: Workflow
description: A workflow definition that describes a multi-step data processing pipeline in the Xceptor platform.

id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow

name.description: The display name of the workflow

description.description: A detailed description of what the workflow does

status.description: The activation status of the workflow

category.description: The category or group the workflow belongs to

trigger_type.description: How the workflow is triggered for execution

schedule.description: The cron expression for scheduled workflows, applicable when trigger_type is scheduled

steps.description: The ordered list of processing steps in the workflow

created_at.description: The date and time the workflow was created

updated_at.description: The date and time the workflow was last updated

created_by.description: The identifier of the user who created the workflow
